sections.heading: Canadian citizenship
paragraphs: Obtain citizenship application information and take advantage of the many resources that are available.

sections.heading: Online
paragraphs: Visit the Citizenship and Immigration website at www.cic.gc.ca. Discover Canada can be downloaded from this website.

sections.heading: Citizenship classes
paragraphs: Contact schools and colleges in your area
Go to your local library or community centre
Contact local settlement agencies or ethnocultural associations

sections.heading: Canada
paragraphs: Ask a librarian to help you find books and videos about Canada. You could begin by asking for these books.
The Canada Yearbook (published by Statistics Canada)
Canada: A Portrait (published by Statistics Canada)
How Canadians Govern Themselves (written by Eugene Forsey)
The Canadian Encyclopedia (including The Youth Encyclopedia of Canada)
The Story of Canada (written by Janet Lunn and Christopher Moore, published by Lester Publishing Ltd.)
Symbols of Canada (published by Canadian Heritage)
A Crown of Maples (published by Canadian Heritage)
Canada: A People’s History (Canadian Broadcasting Corporation)
Canada’s History (published by Canada’s National History Society)
Kayak: Canada’s History Magazine for Kids (published by Canada’s National History Society)

paragraphs: You can obtain information about Canada by telephone or on the Internet:

sections.heading: Internet:
